testimonials.title: Real User Feedback
testimonials.subtitle: See how they got their dream offers

items.text: Not a CS major, self-taught for over a year, always felt my foundation was weak. Interview Master's resume prediction is amazing. The questions generated based on my project experience had a high hit rate, 90% were encountered in actual interviews. Especially deep questions on Spring framework, from IOC to AOP, starting from the logic of the question allowed me to connect the knowledge system from shallow to deep. This feeling of going from value to depth is really great.
items.title: Experienced Hire - Java Developer

items.text: The 996 work schedule left me no time to find someone for mock interviews. Interview Master is available 24/7 for practice, highly efficient. Practicing for 30 minutes every night, the position interviewer would ask about system architecture design and link combing thinking, Interview Master covered it all. Finally gave improvement suggestions. After interviewing with real big tech companies, I encountered 70% similar questions as in the formal interview!
items.title: In-service Promotion - Go Developer

items.text: Used Interview Master mock interview, the ability to follow up on technical details has improved significantly! The mock interview would follow up deeply based on my answers, even details like Redis AOF and optimization could be expanded, and finally gave improvement suggestions. After interviewing with real big tech companies, I encountered 70% similar questions as in the formal interview!
items.title: Architect

items.text: Worked for three years and wanted to aim for big tech companies, but system design has always been a shortcoming. Interview Master's detailed evaluation report + improvement suggestions and question analysis, efficient tempering, continuous improvement, practical combat. Now I can explain the plan clearly in the interview and get a satisfactory salary.
items.title: Backend Developer

items.text: Great! The price might be 1/10 of manual services, the effect is at least 80-90%, super high cost performance!
items.title: Backend Developer

items.text: Django ORM optimization and export views are all involved, interview preparation is very comprehensive.

items.question: Why use Interview Master instead of general AI like Doubao or ChatGPT?
items.answer: Interview Master is deeply customized for job interview scenarios. The real interview standards, follow-up logic, and evaluation system are closer to the requirements of employers.

items.question: What problem does Interview Master solve?
items.answer: Helps you find weak points before the real interview and provides targeted training, outputting structured evaluation and improvement suggestions.

items.question: Who is Interview Master suitable for?
items.answer: From campus recruitment to experienced hires, from job transfer to promotion, everyone can use it; supports multi-position interview simulation.
